title: 实验室里的五类常见危害

author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/20_Stay Safe In The Lab Common Hazards To Watch Out For Training Course/src.py

points.K1: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
points.K2: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
points.K3: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
points.K4: 生物危害：看不见的风险
points.K7: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
points.K8: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
points.K10: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污
points.K12: 长时间移液，先调好工位

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the doorway of a busy teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识实验室里的常见危害。
overlay: 实验室里的五类常见危害

shots.scene: 化学、生物、物理、放射、人体五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a flask, a biohazard symbol, a flame with a lightning bolt, a radiation trefoil and a bent back. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、放射、人体负荷。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进实验室，东张西望
shots.prompt_en: On his first day, the young male student walks into the lab and looks around curiously at benches, bottles and equipment.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，看什么都新鲜。

shots.scene: 老周递给他一张空白的危害清单
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the young male student a blank checklist card with five hazard icons on it.
shots.narration: 老周说：先认清危险，再动手。

shots.section_title: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
shots.scene: 一半明亮的火焰图标，一半半透明的气体图标
shots.prompt_en: Split image: on one side an obvious flame icon, on the other side a faint, almost invisible gas cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的危害一眼可见，有的藏得很深。
overlay: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉

shots.section_title: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
shots.scene: 欣欣睁大眼睛，竖起耳朵
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks around alertly with wide eyes.
shots.narration: 两种都会出事，时刻保持警觉。

shots.section_title: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
shots.scene: 试剂架上的瓶子，挂着骷髅、火焰、问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent shelf with blank-labeled bottles; small icons of a skull, a flame and a question mark float above them. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品有的有毒，有的易燃，有的难测。
overlay: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测

shots.section_title: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
shots.scene: 洒漏、泄漏、着火三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tipped bottle spilling, a leaking cap, and a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 一不留神，洒漏、泄漏、着火就在瞬间。

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的溶剂洒在台面上
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a blank label and a flammable warning sign tips over and spills clear liquid on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 比如洒了丙酮这样的易燃溶剂。
overlay: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 小研关闭附近加热板和燃气阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off a nearby hot plate and closes a gas valve.
shots.narration: 第一步：关掉或移走一切火源。

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 通风柜开启，气流箭头；吸附棉围住洒漏
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood fan runs with airflow arrows, and absorbent pads surround the spill on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，围住洒漏，易燃物挪远。

shots.section_title: 生物危害：看不见的风险
shots.scene: 显微镜下的病原小圆点和花粉颗粒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of tiny germs and pollen-like allergen particles seen through a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 病原体、过敏原，看不见也摸不着。
overlay: 生物危害：看不见的风险

shots.section_title: 生物危害：看不见的风险
shots.scene: 手套上沾着看不见的小点，逐渐扩散到门把手
shots.prompt_en: Tiny dots spread from a gloved hand onto a door handle and a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 稍不小心，污染就扩散开了。

shots.scene: 注射器针头从手中滑脱，手指上出现警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe slipping from a gloved hand with a warning mark on a finger. No people.
shots.narration: 操作针头时一滑，就可能被扎伤。

shots.scene: 血滴图标旁出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A blood drop icon with a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 接触到带血样本，就有感染风险。

shots.scene: 停止、围堵、喷壶、规程本四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a stop hand, a barrier, a spray bottle and a blank procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 停下、控制、消毒，按规程处理。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
shots.scene: 火焰、闪电、湿地板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame, a lightning bolt on a plug, and a wet floor with a slipping person. No people.
shots.narration: 火、电、湿滑地面，天天都在身边。
overlay: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
shots.scene: 阿杰踩着地上一摊水快步走过
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks quickly without noticing a puddle of water on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 越常见，越容易被忽视。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 本生灯火焰离溶剂瓶太近，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lit burner flame too close to a solvent bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰离化学品太近，台面就会着火。
overlay: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 欣欣双手下压，示意冷静
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the air with both hands, signaling to stay calm.
shots.narration: 着火了，先别慌。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 小研取下墙上的灭火器，对准火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a fire extinguisher from the wall and aims it at the base of a small bench fire.
shots.narration: 小火且会用，用灭火器在蔓延前扑灭。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 撤离箭头和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An evacuation arrow pointing to a door and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 火大或没把握，立即撤离报警。

shots.scene: 带电离辐射警告标志的铅罐和防护服图标
shots.prompt_en: A shielded container marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign, next to a protective coverall icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质，污染和照射都不能小看。

shots.section_title: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污
shots.scene: 门口拉起警示带，旁边检测仪和抹布图标
shots.prompt_en: Warning tape across a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign, beside icons of a survey meter and a cleaning cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污。
overlay: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污

shots.scene: 小研一手长时间按移液器，手腕亮起红点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pipettes repeatedly, and small red strain marks glow on her wrist and shoulder.
shots.narration: 同一动作重复几个小时，

shots.scene: 手腕、肩、腰三个红点图标
shots.prompt_en: A body outline icon with red marks on the wrist, shoulder and lower back. No people.
shots.narration: 身体会慢慢累出毛病。

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，先调好工位
shots.scene: 小研弯腰驼背在过高的台面前移液，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person hunched over a bench that is too high while pipetting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工位不合适，腰背手腕迟早会疼。
overlay: 长时间移液，先调好工位

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，先调好工位
shots.scene: 小研调好椅子高度，坐直继续工作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair height and sits up straight at the bench.
shots.narration: 现在调整工位，免得日后受罪。

shots.scene: 实验室门口的安全信息牌，内容为图标
shots.prompt_en: A safety information board beside a lab door, showing only hazard pictograms, a blank name field and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先看门口安全信息牌。

shots.scene: 危险类别、负责人、应急电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: hazard pictograms, a person badge and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 这里有什么危险、找谁、打什么电话。

shots.scene: 小研点燃本生灯，周围台面清空
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles, lights a burner on a bench cleared of bottles and paper.
shots.narration: 用明火前，周围清走易燃物。

shots.scene: 火焰燃着人离开的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lit burner left alone with a person walking away, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 火开着，人不能走开。

shots.scene: 用完关闭燃气阀，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns off the gas valve and the burner flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 用完随手关阀，确认熄灭。

shots.scene: 动物饲养笼旁浮起细小毛屑颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Fine dander particles float up from a lab animal cage. No people.
shots.narration: 实验动物的毛屑和尿液，会引起过敏。

shots.scene: 小研戴口罩、手套、穿隔离衣操作动物笼
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a mask, gloves and a gown, handles a lab animal cage inside a ventilated cabinet.
shots.narration: 戴口罩手套，在通风设备里操作。

shots.scene: 打喷嚏、皮疹图标旁出现电话
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sneeze and a skin rash next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出现过敏症状，及时就医并告诉老师。

shots.scene: 手腕保持平直、肩膀放松的姿势示意
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram of a person seated at a bench with a straight wrist, relaxed shoulders and feet flat on a footrest. No people.
shots.narration: 手腕平直，肩膀放松，双脚踩稳。

shots.scene: 电动移液器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An electronic pipette icon with a green check mark beside a manual pipette icon. No people.
shots.narration: 大量移液，可以换用电动移液器。

shots.scene: 小研放下移液器，活动手腕和肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts down her pipette and stretches her wrists and shoulders.
shots.narration: 隔一阵停下来，活动活动。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五类危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating hazard icons.
shots.narration: 五类危害，各有各的防法。

shots.scene: 安全信息牌和火源熄灭图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety information board and a burner with its flame off. No people.
shots.narration: 先看信息牌，明火不离人。

shots.scene: 停止手势和检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stop hand and a survey meter. No people.
shots.narration: 出事先控制，再按规程处理。

shots.scene: 端正坐姿图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person sitting upright at a bench with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 工位调舒服，身体少受罪。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab doorway.
shots.narration: 看清危害，处处留心，下次见！
